name: 农机具作业效率对比器

map.计算并对比多台农机的工作效率（亩/小时）、油耗与经济性: Compute and compare work efficiency (mu/hour), fuel use, and economy of multiple machines
map.理论生产率 = 幅宽(m) × 速度(km/h) × 0.15 (亩/h)；实际: Theoretical rate = width (m) x speed (km/h) x 0.15 (mu/h); actual rate = theoretical x time-utilization%; work hours = total area / actual rate; cost/mu = (fuel cost + labor cost) / total area
map.经验换算：幅宽 1 m、速度 1 km/h 约合 0.15 亩/h（由 1 km: Empirical conversion: width 1 m, speed 1 km/h is about 0.15 mu/h (from 1 km x 1 m = 1000 m2 = 1.5 mu, times 0.001 h factor). Theoretical rate times time utilization gives actual rate, then work hours from total area; fuel by hourly use x hours x price, labor by hours x hourly fee, converted to per-area cost for cross-comparing and selecting machines.
map.折算亩油耗、亩成本横向对比机型。: Convert to fuel/mu and cost/mu to compare models.
map.用于购机选型与外包作业比价。: Used for purchase selection and outsourced-work pricing.
map.A 机 8 h 收 320 亩 = 40 亩/h、耗油 1.1 L/亩；B 机: Machine A: 8 h harvest 320 mu = 40 mu/h, fuel 1.1 L/mu; B: 8 h 280 mu = 35 mu/h, fuel 1.0 L/mu. A is efficient but fuel-costly; combined cost/mu A 18 yuan vs B 17 yuan, depending on workload spreading fixed cost.
map.不够。还要看油耗、破损率、适应地形。高效率若伴随高损失或高油耗，综合未必划算，应: No. Also fuel, breakage rate, and terrain fit. High efficiency with high loss or high fuel may not pay; compute "comprehensive cost/mu + quality".
map.为什么同一机不同地块效率差？: Why does the same machine differ by field?
map.地块规整度、作物倒伏、土壤湿度、转弯掉头次数都影响。对比应在同类条件下，或取多地: Field regularity, crop lodging, soil moisture, and turning frequency all matter. Compare under similar conditions or use multi-field averages.
map.农机具作业效率对比器是一款农业种植领域的在线工具。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数: The Farm-Machinery Efficiency Comparator is an online agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
